summary: 23/23 SRanger requirements implemented in 8 Java files; javac clean. Four review points: SR-DM4 output shape, endTask vs timed-transition priority in Turning, tick self-loop ordering, and two invented defaults.

issues.title: SR-DM4 realised as a two-argument actuator call, not an event record
issues.raw: A RoboChart event carries a single payload; an OutputEvent.Move record would lose the angular velocity in extraction. Actuator.move(lv, av) extracts as an LOperations call carrying both.
issues.fix_directive: If SR-DM4 must be a sealed-interface event record, accept that the extracted model carries only the linear velocity.

issues.title: Shutdown priority vs. the timed transition in Turning
issues.raw: SR-Beh5 (autonomous, timed) and SR-Beh6 (endTask) both leave Turning with no stated priority. endTask is placed first per the project's operator-override rule; preflight rule8 will warn.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm endTask should pre-empt the timed Turning->Moving transition, or reorder.

issues.title: Turning tick self-loop ordered after the timed transition
issues.raw: SR-Beh7's tick self-loop follows SR-Beh5 and carries && !turnDurationElapsed; tick arrives every cycle, so the reverse order would starve SR-Beh5.
issues.fix_directive: None required unless the requirements intend tick to pre-empt the timed transition.

issues.title: Clock unit (seconds) and the sensor's large default reading (1000.0 m)
issues.raw: SR-Var1 does not fix a time unit; seconds keeps TURN_DURATION at 2.0 exactly. SR-DM5 asks for 'a large default value' without a number.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm 1000.0 m is an acceptable no-reading default and that seconds is the intended clock unit.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
